summary: BI-85389A35 (EP-5F6369AB). Migration 20261028060000_graph_relation_type adds the graph_relation_type lookup (GraphRelationType), the GraphRelationClass and GraphRelationStatus enums, an index on graph_edge.rel_type, and a NOT VALID foreign key from graph_edge.rel_type to the lookup. graph_edge.rel_type stops being free text: an unregistered relation type is refused from any writer, raw SQL included. Rows mirror packages/db/src/relation-vocabulary-entries.ts.
affectedCopies: graph_relation_type rows: written by migrations only; relation-vocabulary.test.ts checks they cover every key in packages/db/src/relation-vocabulary-entries.ts

graph_edge.rel_type: written by upsertGraphEdge (packages/db/src/graph-sync.ts) and the code-graph projection (apps/web/lib/build/code-graph/graph-projection.ts), both of which now run assertRelationWrite before the write
Read by pg-graph.ts traversals and the admin graph explorer, whose relationship labels now come from the registry

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: public: a platform vocabulary of relation names, labels and classes. No organization, person or customer content.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: Reference data shipped with the platform; identical on every install.

migration.name: 20261028060000_graph_relation_type
migration.backfill: None. The migration inserts all 66 registered types; on the dev install on 2026-10-28, every one of the 84,258 existing graph_edge rows names a registered type (verified in a rolled-back transaction). The foreign key is NOT VALID, so an install whose mirror holds an older unregistered type still migrates; the retype items BI-28C22BE3 and BI-92804832 validate it.
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive. Dropping the constraint and table restores free-text rel_type; older code never reads the table.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Reference data, changed only by migration; rows are never deleted while an edge uses them (ON DELETE RESTRICT).
